formatNotes: Seventh CrossFit Games and the second at the renamed StubHub Center (formerly Home Depot Center). Qualification ran through the worldwide Open and 17 Regionals. 46 men and 44 women started (the official leaderboard lists 47 men, but Mikko Salo recorded no scores and withdrew before the first event). 12 separately scored events: a surprise pool swim and a half-marathon row on Wednesday, two days before the main competition opened, then three events each on Friday, Saturday and Sunday (no individual events Thursday, which belonged to Masters and teams). The half-marathon row was scored as two events: Row 1 at the 2,000-meter checkpoint and Row 2 for the full 21,097 meters. Every event was worth up to 100 points on the same placement-points table as 2012. All athletes competed through Event 10 (Sprint Chipper), after which only the top 30 men and top 30 women advanced to the final two events, The Cinco 1 and The Cinco 2, run back to back with exactly one minute between them. Athletes who did not finish within a time cap had one second added to their time for each repetition not completed.
yearSummary: The 2013 programming stretched the field in both directions: a surprise 500-yard pool swim with bar muscle-ups held offsite two days early, a half-marathon row that kept athletes on the erg for 80-95 minutes, and a strongman-flavored Burden Run that debuted the Pig, alongside pure sprints and a heavy clean-and-jerk ladder. Rich Froning opened with a 30th-place finish in the Pool, the worst Games event result of his career, then climbed all week and swept the final three events to clinch his third consecutive title (962 points to Jason Khalipa's 890). Britain's Samantha Briggs was relentless up front, winning Row 1 (in a tie), Row 2 and the Sprint Chipper and never falling out of contention, becoming the first champion from the UK; Lindsey Valenzuela was second and Valerie Voboril took third on a tiebreaker over Alessandra Pichelli after both finished with 818 points. New tests included bar muscle-ups, legless rope climbs, kettlebell-weighted pistols, burpees over a 6-foot wall and the Pig, and the top-30 cut before the finals was the first mid-competition cut since 2011. Josh Bridges won three events (Legless, Naughty Nancy and 2007) and rookie Amanda Goodman stole the clean-and-jerk ladder from last place overall with a 10-lb PR.

events.name: The Pool
events.description:
10 rounds for time of:
Swim 25 yards
3 Bar muscle-ups
Swim 25 yards
25-minute time cap.
Held Wednesday morning at the Woollett Aquatics Center in Irvine, Calif., two days before the main competition opened at the StubHub Center. Athletes swam a length, exited the water for 3 bar muscle-ups on a rig at the pool deck, then swam back, 10 times through (500 yards of swimming and 30 bar muscle-ups total).
events.notes: Surprise event announced shortly before the Games and contested before the official start. First pool swim in Games history (the 2011 and 2012 swims were in the ocean) and the Games debut of the bar muscle-up. Ben Smith was 2nd (10:28.5) and Josh Bridges 3rd (10:59.9) for the men; Kara Webb 2nd (13:55.9) and Rory Zambard 3rd (14:06.5) for the women. Rich Froning finished 30th (14:02.1), the worst Games event finish of his career to that point, setting up his comeback storyline. The official leaderboard spells the women's winner 'Michele Letendre' (often written 'Michelle' in recaps).

events.name: Row 1
events.description:
Row 21,097 meters for time.
Row 1 was the first scored segment of the half-marathon row, contested Wednesday afternoon on Concept2 ergs inside the VELO Sports Center velodrome. Athletes received points based on their time at the 2,000-meter checkpoint. There was no scheduled rest at the checkpoint; the race continued immediately as part of Row 2.
events.notes: Scored as a separate 100-point event at the 2K mark of the half-marathon row; finishing order here had no bearing on Row 2 scoring. Athletes had to gamble on pacing a 2K sprint at the front of a 21,097-meter race. Briggs and former collegiate rower Ladeairous tied at 7:17.0 for the women; Rich Froning was 2nd for the men (6:34.5) and Simon Paquette 3rd (6:35.9). The 2-hour overall cap applied to the full distance, not this segment.

events.name: Row 2
events.description:
Row 21,097 meters (a half marathon) for time.
Row 2 was scored as the total time to complete the entire 21,097 meters, inclusive of the Row 1 segment. Finishing order at the 2,000-meter checkpoint (Row 1) had no bearing on the scoring for Row 2.
Time cap: 2 hours for men, 2 hours 10 minutes for women.
Contested on Concept2 ergs inside the VELO Sports Center velodrome.
events.notes: The longest single effort in Games history at the time, keeping athletes on the erg for roughly 80 to 95 minutes. Time cap listed is the men's; women had 2 hours 10 minutes. Neal Maddox was 2nd for the men (1:19:25.9) and Justin Allen 3rd (1:19:39.7); Margaux Alvarez (1:29:02.2) and Ruth Anderson Horrell (1:29:18.4) followed Briggs for the women. Khalipa's double event win on the ergs vaulted him into early contention.

events.name: Burden Run
events.description:
For time:
Run 2.1 miles
Flip the Pig 100 yards (490-lb Pig men / 310-lb Pig women)
600-yard Log carry (100-lb log men / 70-lb log women)
Drag the Iditarod sled 66 yards (310-lb sled men / 220-lb sled women)
40-minute time cap.
Contested Friday morning (10:30 a.m. to 12:15 p.m.) on the track and in the soccer stadium. Implement weights were not printed on the official event card; they are as reported by Wikipedia.
events.notes: Games debut of the Pig, the giant steel-and-foam flipping box that became a recurring Games implement. With much lighter burdens, the women's winning time (28:03.9 by Ladeairous) was faster than the men's. Ben Smith was 2nd for the men (29:46.2) and Daniel Petro 3rd (29:53.0); Ruth Anderson Horrell was 2nd for the women (28:27.3) and Briggs 3rd (29:39.6). Khalipa's third straight event win.

events.name: ZigZag Sprint
events.description:
Sprint to the finish line 50 yards away, navigating around four padded obstacles (pylons).
4-round bracketed tournament contested Friday afternoon (1:00 to 2:45 p.m.) in the soccer stadium: six athletes raced head to head in each heat, with the top three finishers from each heat advancing to the next round. Places 1-6 were awarded to the athletes in the final round by finishing order; places 7-12 to third-round athletes by time; places 13-24 to second-round athletes by time; places 25 on to the remaining athletes by their first-round times.
events.notes: Pure head-to-head footspeed test, following 2012's straight-line sprint. Former Ohio State fullback Marcus Hendren beat Dan Bailey (2nd, by a margin officials measured to a thousandth of a second) and Aja Barto (3rd) in the men's final; per the games.crossfit.com recap 'Bracketology', Hendren's winning final time was 11.1 seconds, and his 10.9 in an earlier round was the fastest run of the day by any athlete. Michelle Crawford took the women's final over Lindy Wall (2nd) and Stacie Tovar (3rd); no time for the women's final was published, so her score stays as placement. Khalipa, the overall leader at the time, tied for 43rd. The official leaderboard records placement (e.g., '1 pt') rather than a time.

events.name: Legless
events.description:
For time:
27 Thrusters (95 lb men / 65 lb women)
4 Legless rope climbs
21 Thrusters (95 / 65 lb)
3 Legless rope climbs
15 Thrusters (95 / 65 lb)
2 Legless rope climbs
9 Thrusters (95 / 65 lb)
1 Legless rope climb
10-minute time cap.
Rope climbs to 15 feet performed without using the legs. Contested Friday night (6:00 to 8:50 p.m.) in the tennis stadium.
events.notes: Games debut of legless rope climbs (10 total), which shredded grip and biceps after a light 72-thruster engine test; many athletes hit the cap with climbs remaining and were scored with one second added per missed rep. Gary Helmick was 2nd for the men (6:08.1, eight tenths back) and Kenneth Leverich 3rd (6:17.6); Christy Phillips was 2nd for the women (9:41.9), with Valerie Voboril and Emily Carothers tied 3rd (10:02.0). Khalipa stalled on the ropes and finished 27th, opening the door for Froning.

events.name: Naughty Nancy
events.description:
Four rounds for time of:
Run 600 meters up and over the berm
25 Overhead squats (140 lb men / 95 lb women)
20-minute time cap.
Each 600-meter lap ran out of the soccer stadium and up and over a dirt berm before returning to the barbells on the field. Contested Saturday morning (8:00 to 9:50 a.m.).
events.notes: A supersized version of the benchmark 'Nancy' (normally 5 rounds of a 400-m run and 15 overhead squats at 95/65 lb): longer hill runs, bigger sets and heavier bars, 100 overhead squats in total. Bridges doubled up after his Legless win the night before; Froning was 2nd (17:19.3) and Khalipa 3rd (17:28.7). Briggs was 2nd for the women (17:27.7) and Voboril 3rd (17:50.2).

events.name: Clean & Jerk Ladder
events.description:
1-rep clean and jerk every 90 seconds with progressively heavier barbells.
Men's bars (lb): 225, 235, 245, 255, 265, 275, 285, 295, 305, 315, 325, 335, 345, 355, 365, 375, 385, 395, 405 (10-lb jumps).
Women's bars (lb): 145, 150, 155, 160, 165, 170, 175, 180, 185, 190, 195, 200, 205, 210, 215, 220, 225, 230, 235, 240, 245, 250 (5-lb jumps).
Four starting points (225 / 255 / 285 / 315 lb for men; 145 / 165 / 185 / 205 lb for women). Athletes were ranked by the weight of their heaviest successful lift, with partial credit awarded for a successful clean with a failed jerk (after at least one successful clean and jerk). An athlete who could not clean and jerk the opening weight was eliminated. Contested Saturday (11:45 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.) in the soccer stadium.
events.notes: Leaderboard decimals encode the partial-credit rule: x.20 means a completed clean and jerk at that weight, x.10 a clean only. Parker and Barto both clean-and-jerked 345 lb and cleaned 355 lb without the jerk to tie for first; Parker matched his C&J PR and set a new personal clean record. Froning jerked 345 lb (345.20, 3rd) to retake the overall lead while Khalipa missed at 335 lb and tied 7th. Games rookie Amanda Goodman, in last place overall entering the event, won the women's ladder with a 235-lb clean and jerk, a 10-lb PR; Lindsey Valenzuela and Elisabeth Akinwale tied 2nd at 235.10 (clean only). Nobody in either division finished the ladder (405 / 250 lb tops).

events.description:
For time:
Row 1,000 meters
Then, five rounds of:
25 Pull-ups
7 Push jerks (135 lb men / 85 lb women)
15-minute time cap.
A recreation of the final event of the inaugural 2007 CrossFit Games (125 pull-ups and 35 push jerks in total). Contested Saturday night (5:40 to 9:00 p.m.) in the tennis stadium.
events.notes: Throwback programming honoring the sport's roots; in 2007 the same workout (with a 1,000-m row on the ranch) decided the first Games. Bridges took his third event win of the weekend; Lacee Kovacs was 2nd (9:10.4) and Daniel Tyminski 3rd (9:12.5, tied with Daniel Petro on the leaderboard sort). For the women, Natalie McLain was 2nd (9:55.5) and Camille Leblanc-Bazinet 3rd (10:03.9).

events.name: Sprint Chipper
events.description:
For time:
21 Medicine-ball GHD sit-ups
15 Snatches (165 lb men / 100 lb women)
9 Wall burpees (burpees over a 6-foot wall)
5-minute time cap.
Contested Sunday (11:00 a.m. to 12:10 p.m.) in the soccer stadium. After this event the field was cut to the top 30 men and top 30 women, who advanced to the final two events.
events.notes: The GHD sit-ups were performed holding a medicine ball; the ball weight was not printed on the official card and is not stated in the games.crossfit.com event recap 'The Fast and the Fittest' either, so it is deliberately left unspecified rather than guessed. The recap confirms the workout as 21 med-ball GHD sit-ups, 15 snatches (165/100 lb) and 9 wall burpees with a 5-minute cap. The 6-foot wall height is per Wikipedia. Most athletes finished in around three minutes. In the women's final heat Jenn Jones cleared the wall first but tripped sprinting for the line, handing Briggs the event win by three tenths (2:35.3 to 2:35.6); Talayna Fortunato was 3rd (2:41.1). Dan Bailey was 2nd for the men (2:30.0) and ZA Anderson 3rd (2:33.6). The first of Froning's three straight event wins to close the Games.

events.name: The Cinco 1
events.description:
For time:
Three rounds of:
5 Deadlifts (405 lb men / 265 lb women)
5 Weighted one-legged squats, left leg (53-lb kettlebell men / 35-lb kettlebell women)
5 Weighted one-legged squats, right leg (53 / 35-lb kettlebell)
Then, 80-foot handstand walk
7-minute time cap. The Cinco 2 began precisely 1 minute after the time cap.
Contested Sunday afternoon (2:00 to 5:00 p.m.) in the tennis stadium by the top 30 men and top 30 women only.
events.notes: First of the back-to-back 'Cinco' finals (everything in fives), contested only by the post-cut top 30. Akinwale's 3:32.2 was the fastest time in either division. Ben Smith was 2nd for the men (4:17.3) and Scott Panchik 3rd (4:25.5); Talayna Fortunato was 2nd for the women (4:36.4) and Danielle Horan 3rd (4:46.6). Athletes still on the floor at the cap had one second added per uncompleted rep, then got one minute of rest before The Cinco 2.

events.name: The Cinco 2
events.description:
For time:
Three rounds of:
5 Muscle-ups
5 Deficit handstand push-ups
Then, 90-foot overhead walking lunge (160-lb axle bar men / 100-lb axle bar women)
7-minute time cap.
Began exactly 1 minute after the end of The Cinco 1's time cap, in the tennis stadium, contested by the top 30 men and top 30 women only. The handstand push-up deficit height was not printed on the official card; the games.crossfit.com retrospective 'How Two Handstand Push-ups Cost Alessandra Pichelli $65,000' describes the women's event as five nine-inch deficit handstand push-ups per round. No equivalent figure was found for the men's deficit.
events.notes: The title-deciding final event. Froning won it (his third straight event win) to finish on 962 points and claim his third consecutive championship; Josh Bridges was 2nd (5:40.8) and Khalipa 3rd (5:52.6). Fortunato edged Camille Leblanc-Bazinet by half a second (6:47.3 to 6:47.8) with Michele Letendre 3rd (7:01.0, a capped score under the plus-one-second-per-rep rule). The deficit handstand push-ups (9-inch deficit for the women, per the games.crossfit.com Pichelli retrospective) wrecked much of the women's final heat; per that article only Fortunato and Valenzuela got through them without trouble, and two missed reps at the cap cost Pichelli her hold on the overall podium. Briggs finished mid-pack but had already sealed the title (920 points); Valerie Voboril took 3rd overall on a tiebreaker over Alessandra Pichelli after both ended with 818 points.
